info.title: AX Request Portal API
info.description:
Contract the AX Request Portal frontend expects. Generated from src/api/contract.ts — do not edit by hand.

Every request carries `Accept-Language` (`ko` or `en`, the language the user picked). Error messages, notification texts and AI-written text should come back in that language.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a bearer token

get.summary: User directory (names are shown on every request)

patch.summary: Change role, team or active flag (user:manage)

get.summary: Projects a request can target, with repository, wiki and owners
List requests visible to the current user

post.summary: Submit a request. The AI starts the feasibility report immediately.

get.summary: Full request with report, work run, checklist and timeline

post.summary: One-shot submission check. Issues are advisory and never block submission.
Move a request through its lifecycle (409 when the transition is not allowed)

409.description: Transition not allowed in this status

put.summary: Save QA checklist progress (requester, while in verification)
The requester's reaction to the preview while the change is in code review (advisory; status unchanged)
Set or change the planned release date (responsible developer)

post.summary: Upload a screenshot or file (multipart field "file", max 10 MB)

get.summary: Open regression checks on requests the developer is responsible for
Notifications for the current user, newest first
Notification channels of the current user

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

get.summary: Planned and past releases grouped by date and project
AI spend against the monthly limit (budget:manage)
Provider connections, model per task and per-project overrides (agent:manage)

put.summary: Choose the model per task and per project (agent:manage). Every selection must be a priced model of a connected provider.
Store or replace a provider API key (agent:manage). The key is write-only.

delete.summary: Disconnect a provider (agent:manage); refused while a task or project still uses it

get.summary: Price table and exchange rate used to book AI usage (agent:manage or usage:view)

put.summary: Edit prices and the exchange rate (agent:manage). Applies to usage booked from now on.

get.summary: AI usage and estimated cost for one month by provider, model, task and request (usage:view)

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

asOf.description: Date the prices were last checked against the providers

usdKrw.description: KRW per USD used to book new usage

AiProvider.description: anthropic = Claude models through the Claude API, and Claude Code for AI work; openai = GPT models through the OpenAI API, and Codex for AI work.

AiRuntime.description: api = one model API call; claude_code / codex = a coding-agent run made of many calls.

AiTask.description: precheck = advice on a draft before submission; report = feasibility report; work = code change and merge request by a coding agent.

requestId.description: Absent for a precheck, which runs before the request exists

calls.description: Model API calls and coding-agent runs booked in `month`

usdKrw.description: Exchange rate in the price table now; entries keep the rate they were booked at

daily.description: One row per day and provider with spending; days without spending are omitted

topRequests.description: Most expensive requests in `month`, at most ten

finding.description: What the reviewer found, in their words

criterionId.description: The acceptance criterion made from this item

finding.description: What the reviewer found, in their words

text.description: Copy of the project constraint when the report was written

conflict.description: The plan, or the code it touches, breaks this constraint

receivedPrevMonth.description: Received in the previous month over the same span of days (month-to-date while `month` is in progress)

delayed.description: Open right now and past the desired or scheduled date

avgLeadTimeDays.description: Average days from submission to release, for requests released during `month`

aiAlertThresholdPct.description: Share of `aiBudgetKrw` at which spending is flagged; the budget's `alertThresholdPct`

constraintChecks.description: Every project constraint and how the plan keeps it; a conflict makes the verdict conditional

generatedBy.description: Provider and model that wrote this revision

cacheWriteUsd.description: USD per 1M tokens written to the cache at the shortest TTL; 0 when not billed

onlyActionRequired.description: Only notify when it is my turn to act

PrecheckIssue.description: Shown next to the field. Never blocks submission.

PreviewFeedback.description: The requester's reaction to the preview. Advisory: the developer still decides on the merge.

PreviewFeedbackInput.description: A change request needs a note so the developer knows what to change.

ProjectConstraint.description: A project rule the AI must respect when it plans and makes a change (security, data, operations). Kept by the project, so requesters never have to repeat it.

text.description: A rule every change must keep, in plain words

reference.description: Where the rule comes from, e.g. "Security policy 3.2"

text.description: A rule every change must keep, in plain words

reference.description: Where the rule comes from, e.g. "Security policy 3.2"

ProjectTarget.description: A screen or feature a requester can pick. Normally extracted from the project wiki.

keyHint.description: Last four characters of the stored key; the key itself is never returned

apiKey.description: Write-only: stored by the server, never returned

source.description: Wiki doc linked to the changed code

ReportAssumption.description: A fact the plan relies on that neither the code nor a reviewed wiki confirmed. The developer checks each one before the AI starts work.

spentKrw.description: Estimated AI cost booked against this request so far

checklistSource.description: Who raised the findings, e.g. "Security audit, on-site review"

checklist.description: Checklist requests only: each item becomes an acceptance criterion

RequestScope.description: mine = filed by me; assigned = projects I own or requests assigned to me; all = everything (needs request:read:all)

RequestStatus.description: See src/domain/lifecycle.ts for the transition table.

RequestType.description: checklist = findings from an outside review (audit, inspection, certification) handled item by item

Role.description: requester = planning/sales staff who file requests; executive = requester + company-wide dashboard; developer = reviews reports, runs AI work, approves merges; admin = manages projects and users; operator = runs the service itself: AI providers and models, prices, AI budget and usage. Operator accounts are provisioned by the service, not by an admin.

ScopeProposal.description: The AI's reading of the request in the requester's words, written with the feasibility report.

revision.description: Report revision this was written with

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences, no technical terms

unchanged.description: What this request will not change

ScopeQuestion.description: A choice the requester makes where the request can be read more than one way.

recommended.description: Option id the AI would pick; never preselected

token.description: Bearer token for the Authorization header

input.description: Input tokens billed at the full input rate (cache reads and writes excluded)

cacheRead.description: Input tokens served from the prompt cache

cacheWrite.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache

reasoning.description: Part of `output` spent on reasoning, when the provider reports it

TransitionCommand.description: Body of POST /requests/{id}/transitions. AI and system events are not accepted from clients.

checkedAssumptions.description: Ids of the report's assumptions the developer confirmed; all of them on the first run

VerificationDraft.description: Saves checklist progress without changing status. Submit with confirmResult / reportIssue.

WikiTrust.description: Derived from wiki review state of the evidence documents, never from model judgement.

WorkPreview.description: What the requester can look at before the merge. Filled by CI or the coding agent; costs no AI.

url.description: A running build of the change, e.g. a preview deployment

scope.description: Scope the requester confirmed (or is asked to); the developer and the AI work from it

aiUsage.description: Returned only to users with report:read

instructions.description: Developer memo or revision note passed to the AI

checkedAssumptions.description: Report assumption ids the developer confirmed before this run started

wikiChanges.description: Wiki docs edited in the same merge request; always pending human review

agent.description: Coding agent and model that made this run
